premises.text: Finding a great car deal in MENA is hard because there is no centralized platform, information is inconsistent or illegitimate, and pricing is not standardized
premises.evidence_span: Finding a great deal is hard because there's no centralized platform, inconsistent and illegitimate information, and no standardized pricing in the MENA region

premises.text: AI-powered search estimates car value and depreciation from a photo and continuously adjusts pricing to the market
premises.evidence_span: Immediately, he sees the estimated value of the car and his expected depreciation. The AI behind the pricing even scans the market to constantly adjust its algorithm

premises.text: Search aggregates all cars on all websites nationwide and surfaces the best deals
premises.evidence_span: immediately sees all cars on all websites in the whole country and finds all the best deals

premises.text: AI negotiation chatbot Caesar contacts dealers to negotiate prices on behalf of the customer before they choose
premises.evidence_span: our AI negotiation chatbot, Caesar, automatically contacts every single dealer to ensure that he gets the best deal out there

premises.text: WhatsApp integration lets buyers contact sellers and book test drives
premises.evidence_span: with the help of our WhatsApp integration, he simply contacts the seller and books a test drive

premises.text: Monetization via OEM/dealer leads, brand business-intelligence tools, and value-added service partners
premises.evidence_span: We work with OEMs and certified dealers to send them leads on their featured cars, both the new and used cars

premises.text: Platform will also show leasing options alongside buying in MENA where leasing penetration is low
premises.evidence_span: you'll be able to lease cars through the C-SAP. So instead of just seeing new and used cars, you can also see the leasing options for these cars
